name: armada-t1-mcp
description: Blackspark Armada T1 — Claude Code only. This plugin exists so the `armada-t1` plugin can depend on it and pin the MCP tool surface by version, a mechanism Codex does not have. On Codex install `armada-t1` instead: it carries the connection itself. Installing this one on Codex contributes nothing, deliberately.

interface.shortDescription: MCP connection to Armada T1 (Claude Code only)
interface.longDescription: The Armada T1 MCP connection. On Claude Code this is installed automatically as a dependency of the Armada T1 plugin, which pins it by version so a change to the tool surface cannot move underneath a workflow. On Codex install "Armada T1" instead — it carries the connection itself, and this plugin contributes nothing here.
